newsitem.title: USA: Natgas home supply choice growing in U.S. - survey.
newsitem.headline: Natgas home supply choice growing in U.S. - survey.

text.p: By 2000, almost one-fourth of all homes in the United States which use natural gas or 12 million households are likely to be able to choose their own gas suppliers, according to a survey by the American Gas Association (AGA).

Local gas utilities in 10 states -- Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Michigan, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin and Wyoming -- have already started offering to deliver gas from outside suppliers to some customers.
